sentences.en: You have a responsibility to explain that behavior to me.
sentences.zh: 你有责任向我解释那种行为。

sentences.en: Everybody respects Jeremy because he carries out all his responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 每个人都尊重杰里米，因为他履行了所有职责。

sentences.en: The driver does not have responsibility for the traffic accident.
sentences.zh: 司机对这次交通事故不负责任。

senses.zh: 责任，义务；职责，工作；责任心；负责的事情，责任范围；责任，义务

mnemonic: 来自responsible（adj. 应负责的，有责任的）
